ai_summary: Mr. Siddharth Bhaskar Shah, a promoter of ARISINFRA SOLUTIONS LIMITED, along with his Persons Acting in Concert (PAC), has increased their collective shareholding from 19.90% to 20.40%. This 0.50% acquisition was made via open market purchases by Mr. Shah, signaling enhanced promoter confidence in the company's prospects. The transaction is a routine disclosure under SEBI regulations and does not present immediate red flags.
